levels.surface: عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير
عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير

notes: «قال ابن جريج وزاد عمرو» gives a second route that adds a sentence: a different transmitter for the same report, so a variant group and not a route (rule 4)
«أبيه» is a relation: the father of عامر, whose name here is the Companion already written
«قال أخبرني زياد» and «أخبرني زياد» are one link each: the speaker and his source are written in full
